description: Recon-app context pipeline: declares the MCP tools that supply external provider context during review

stages.name: preflight
stages.description: Runs dependency audit, environment config check, and infrastructure topology scan

stages.name: reputation_lookup
stages.description: Returns VirusTotal v3 / GSB v4 schema for reputation route handlers

stages.name: cve_lookup
stages.description: Returns NVD/vulners CVE entries for vulnerability-scanning code paths

stages.name: breach_lookup
stages.description: Returns LeakCheck v2 response shape for breach-check route handlers

stages.name: cloud_bucket_inventory
stages.description: Returns public-bucket enumeration shape for cloud-buckets route handlers

stages.name: verify_cloud_posture
stages.description: Returns cloud deployment posture baseline for deployment-context changes
